research.citation: [Digital Dubai, GITEX Europe announcement](https://www.digitaldubai.ae/newsroom/news/dubai-to-make-presence-felt-at-gitex-europe-x-ai-everything-2025-with-a-joint-pavilion-featuring-12-government-and-private-entities), May 2025; also [Dubai Government Media Office, 18 May 2025](https://www.mediaoffice.ae/en/news/2025/may/18-05/dubai-to-make-presence-felt-at-gitex-europe-x-ai)
research.finding: Smart Employee served over 76,000 employees across 76 government entities.
research.limits: Strong first-party scale benchmark. Do not add entity headcounts to this aggregate or treat HR self-service users as paid signature users.

research.citation: [DEWA Integrated Report 2025](https://www.dewa.gov.ae/-/media/Files/Investor-Relations-Files/Integrated-report-for-the-year-2025.ashx), printed p.117; [issuer filing on DFM](https://feeds.dfm.ae/documents/2026/Mar/23/b94e2b1a-48b8-4fa8-b35b-542a63444231/DEWA%20Integrated%20Repo.pdf), workforce table p.161
research.limits: Workforce context for DEWA. Primary search-index extracts corroborate the total; full DEWA PDF retrieval exceeded tool size limit. Operational workers are not automatically paid sign users.

research.citation: [Dubai Government, Dubai Health identity announcement](https://mediaoffice.ae/en/news/2023/November/11-11/Dubai-Health), 11 November 2023; [Dubai Health, Clinic of Hope announcement](https://dubaihealth.ae/w/dubai-health-marks-zayed-humanitarian-day-with-the-inauguration-of-the-clinic-of-hope-), 2024
research.finding: More than 11,000 professionals in the 2023 announcement; 2024 entity announcement describes 11,000 employees. Dubai Academic Health Corporation operates as Dubai Health. DHA has a separate regulatory role.
research.limits: Historical workforce scale; one delivery-system population, not two. Do not reuse historic DHA headcounts without accounting for restructuring, or assume all clinicians need Circularo seats.

research.citation: [du Sustainability Report 2025](https://investors.du.ae/static-files/db00b561-a6f2-41e5-a0de-c73bbad518d2), p.13; [du Annual Report](https://investors.du.ae/static-files/a619c2a1-f3e3-4552-b9b1-3d41b65f4723), human-capital section
research.limits: Entity/corporate workforce context, subject to procurement-scope confirmation. The sustainability report introduction identifies 2025, but its GRI index contains a 2024 period statement; retain this source inconsistency. Annual-report search extract corroborates the number.

research.citation: [ICD Annual Report 2025](https://icd.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/ICD-AR2025-Full-Report-2.pdf), Dubai Duty Free profile pp.116–117
research.finding: Dubai Duty Free reports 5,800+ employees supporting operations.
research.limits: Search-index evidence; full PDF retrieval failed. Do not turn this rounded floor into an exact count, or count it again inside ICD-wide workforce.
Reported but undated; not accepted as a current 2026 count. A recent crawl does not establish a recent underlying observation.

research.citation: [Dubai Government Media Office, Dubai Ambulance performance](https://www.mediaoffice.ae/en/news/2024/april/04-04/dubai-ambulance-responds-to-over), 4 April 2024, covering 2023
research.finding: Describes 1,375 personnel managing and operating specialized ambulance services.
research.limits: Operational-team scope, not established total entity headcount; use only as contextual evidence. S03's 275 licensed users remains the direct current-customer input.

research.finding: An employee-category table includes a 2024 total of 3,259.
research.limits: Candidate only: text extraction and search rendering differ in language/layout; screenshot retrieval failed. Confirm table purpose and population before using this as workforce or an adoption denominator. Keep S03's 1,000 users.

research.finding: Search extract places 1,275 beside total employees, with separate administrative and judicial metrics.
research.limits: Candidate only: full retrieval failed and visual association was not verified. Do not use 1,275 in a base-case calculation until the source page is confirmed.
Undated self-description; similar figures appear in much older coverage. Lower confidence than a dated annual report; do not treat as current verified workforce.

research.finding: Dubai Economy and Dubai Tourism merged into the Department of Economy and Tourism.
research.limits: Supports predecessor/alias review. No workforce count is supplied; do not sum their historic workforces with DET.

research.finding: Nedaa is the Professional Communication Corporation.
research.limits: Source names for the two Nedaa rows refer to the same named organization; retain both raw rows, propose one demand group.

research.finding: DIEZ covers DAFZ, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Dubai CommerCity.

research.finding: Its Happiness Club reached over 76,000 employees across 39 companies.
